title: SRM Hysteresis Current Controller
text: 开关磁阻电机的滞环电流控制，输入 6 路、输出 1 路；{Torque capability angle (rad)} 指定转矩能力角、{Hysteresis band (A)} 指定滞环带宽、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: Sabc
ports.summary: 电压开关信号 vector | 0 or 1

params.name: Torque capability angle (rad)
params.values: 转矩能力角 pi/2 (default) | [0, 2*pi/number of rotor poles]

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar
